nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the REGOS integrations gateway: a Node 20 stage compiles the TSD PWA client assets, then a Python 3.12-slim stage installs dependencies, copies the app plus built assets, sets the Asia/Tashkent timezone, and launches the FastAPI app via uvicorn on port 80.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build separates the Node client-asset compilation from the final Python runtime image, copying only the built PWA assets into the slim Python image to keep it small.

nodes.name: client-builder
nodes.summary: Node 20-alpine build stage that runs npm ci and npm run build to compile the TSD PWA frontend assets under clients/tsd/pwa.

nodes.name: python
nodes.summary: Final python:3.12-slim runtime stage that installs Python requirements, copies the application and the prebuilt PWA assets, configures the Asia/Tashkent timezone, and runs the FastAPI server via uvicorn on port 80.
